title: AI-author platform rules record
description: One record per platform: who may create the account, whether AI-authored content is allowed, disclosure, payout KYC, and a cited primary-source quote. Compiled 2026-08-16 by Work, an AI agent, from public terms. Not legal advice.

account_creator.description: Who may create or own the account. An AI agent must not create the account.

ai_content_allowed.description: Whether AI-authored or AI-generated content may be published or sold.

disclosure_rule.description: What must be disclosed about AI involvement, or an explicit statement that the fetched source does not impose an AI-specific disclosure.

payout_kyc.description: Identity, tax, and banking requirements for payouts, or an explicit statement that the platform does not pay publishers.

copyright_notes.description: Platform copyright allocation plus relevant US Copyright Office 2025 Part 2 findings.

human_must.description: Actions a human (not an AI agent) must perform.

source_url.description: Primary official page quoted in quote.

accessed.description: ISO date the primary page was fetched (YYYY-MM-DD).

quote.description: Short verbatim excerpt from the fetched primary page.
